$comment: Historical goals with their reasons for the east's realms (plan-1378 §2), from start-date/research/east.md. Weighed by the AI from milestone 10 step 6; never forced.

goals.goal: Take the Bulgarian and Macedonian lowlands: Sofia, Serres, Niš
goals.reason: Ghaza and timar land for frontier lords; Evrenos and Lala Şahin push west
goals.deviation: Turn to Anatolia first (Germiyan, Hamid, Karaman)

goals.goal: Keep Byzantium a tributary and play its civil war
goals.reason: Control of the straits and the Gallipoli crossing; tribute and troops
goals.ends_when: Constantinople falls or Byzantium breaks free
goals.deviation: Besiege Constantinople early

goals.goal: Gain Anatolian land by marriage and purchase (Germiyan dowry, Hamid sale)
goals.reason: Anatolian revenue and men without wars on Muslim neighbours
goals.ends_when: Holds Kütahya and the Hamid lands
goals.deviation: Annex Germiyan by force

goals.goal: Take Thessaloniki
goals.reason: The second city of the Balkans; Manuel II's base
goals.deviation: Push into Albania via Savra

goals.goal: Break Lazar's Serbia
goals.reason: Lazar's coalition blocks the road north
goals.deviation: Accept Serbian tribute and peace

goals.goal: Andronikos IV keeps the throne against John V and Manuel
goals.reason: Usurper's need for Ottoman and Genoese backing
goals.ends_when: Andronikos dead or reconciled as heir (1381)
goals.deviation: Flee to Pera and bargain for an appanage

goals.goal: John V's faction recovers Constantinople
goals.reason: Legitimacy; imprisonment
goals.ends_when: John V holds the capital (historically 1 Jul 1379)
goals.deviation: Rule from Thessaloniki

goals.goal: Get Western help (union, crusade)
goals.reason: Ottoman encirclement; John V's 1369 Roman conversion
goals.ends_when: A crusade comes or the Ottomans are broken
goals.deviation: Full submission to the Ottomans

goals.goal: Manuel II holds Thessaloniki independently
goals.reason: Manuel's own resistance policy
goals.ends_when: Thessaloniki falls or Manuel reconciles with Murad
goals.deviation: Join his father's tributary line

goals.goal: Push back Achaea and the Latins
goals.reason: Unify the Peloponnese for the empire
goals.deviation: Ally with the Navarrese against the Ottomans

goals.goal: Keep the throne as an Ottoman vassal
goals.reason: Kera Tamara tie; weakness after 1371
goals.ends_when: Tarnovo falls or the Ottomans are broken
goals.deviation: Revolt with Lazar or Hungary

goals.goal: Survive between Hungary and the Ottomans
goals.reason: Hungarian vassal; rivalry with Tarnovo
goals.deviation: Join a crusade (Nikopolis)

goals.goal: Win the Black Sea trade war with Genoa
goals.reason: Control of coast and shipping
goals.deviation: Seek Wallachian protection

goals.goal: Unite the Serbian lands under Lazar
goals.reason: Nemanjić vacuum after 1371; church support
goals.ends_when: Lazar holds Braničevo and the Morava
goals.deviation: Accept Ottoman tribute and peace

goals.goal: Stop the Ottomans at the Morava
goals.reason: Raids; Niš lost 1386
goals.ends_when: Ottomans defeated or Serbia a vassal
goals.deviation: Seek Hungarian protection

goals.goal: Hold Kosovo and Skopje
goals.reason: His own lordship and the Lazar alliance
goals.deviation: Become an Ottoman vassal early

goals.goal: Take Durrës and lead Albania
goals.reason: Balša II's ambition; title Duke of Durazzo
goals.deviation: Seek Venetian protection

goals.goal: Hold Durrës against the Balšići
goals.reason: Thopia's core port
goals.deviation: Call in the Ottomans (1385) or sell to Venice

goals.goal: Win the Adriatic coast and the Serbian crown lands
goals.reason: Royal title of 1377; Kotor and Dalmatian towns
goals.ends_when: Holds Kotor and the coastal towns
goals.deviation: Intervene in Hungary after Louis's death

goals.goal: Keep inland trade and neutrality
goals.reason: Silver trade is the city's life
goals.deviation: Pivot to shipping

goals.goal: Keep the throne free of Hungarian control
goals.reason: Hungarian claims
goals.ends_when: Hungary or the Ottomans impose a vassal tie
goals.deviation: Take Dobruja (Mircea, c.1388)

goals.goal: Defend the duchy and choose an overlord (Sicily or Aragon)
goals.reason: Catalan settlers need a protector
goals.deviation: Hire the Navarrese

goals.goal: Survive under its leaseholder and claimants
goals.reason: Absent prince, rival claimants
goals.deviation: Hire the Navarrese as rulers

goals.goal: Take Ioannina
goals.reason: Albanian clans moving into Epirus
goals.deviation: Ransom diplomacy with the West

goals.goal: Survive against the Albanians with Ottoman help
goals.reason: Isolation; unpopular ruler
goals.deviation: Seek Florentine (Buondelmonti) ties

goals.goal: Gain mainland Epirus
goals.reason: Tocco ambition; Buondelmonti ties to Ioannina
goals.deviation: Stay in the islands under Venice

goals.goal: Recover Famagusta
goals.reason: Royal port held by Genoa since 1374
goals.deviation: Accept Genoese terms (1383) to free James I

goals.goal: Hold Rhodes and Smyrna; fight Turkish piracy
goals.reason: The Order's mission and Levant trade
goals.deviation: Expand in Greece (Achaea, Corinth)

goals.goal: Ransom the Grand Master
goals.reason: Heredia captive in Epirus

goals.goal: Keep the island and back John V
goals.reason: Family tie to John V
goals.deviation: Pay the Ottomans

goals.goal: Keep the islands under Venice
goals.reason: Small and exposed

goals.goal: Protect trade
goals.reason: Mastic and alum
goals.deviation: Pay the Ottomans

goals.goal: Survive as a Byzantine dependency
goals.reason: Weak isolated lordship
goals.deviation: Ottoman vassal

goals.goal: Lead Anatolia and stop Ottoman growth
goals.reason: Claim to the Seljuk heritage of Konya
goals.deviation: Accept Ottoman marriage and peace

goals.goal: Take the Hamid lands (Beyşehir)
goals.reason: Neighbouring land and Seljuk claim
goals.ends_when: Holds Beyşehir, or the Ottomans hold it
goals.deviation: Expand east to Kayseri

goals.goal: Secure the dynasty by an Ottoman marriage
goals.reason: Pressure from Karaman and the Ottomans
goals.deviation: Ally with Karaman

goals.goal: Keep Ayasoluk and the trade with Venice
goals.reason: Port income
goals.deviation: Raid the Aegean

goals.goal: Retake the Smyrna harbour castle
goals.reason: Lost to the crusaders 1344

goals.goal: Keep Balat and Milas trade
goals.reason: Port income
goals.deviation: Raid Rhodes and the islands

goals.goal: Survive between Aydın and the Ottomans
goals.reason: Small and exposed
goals.deviation: Ottoman vassal

goals.goal: Sell or hand land to the Ottomans for protection
goals.reason: Karaman pressure
goals.deviation: Ally with Karaman

goals.goal: Hold Antalya
goals.reason: Port retaken from Cyprus in 1373

goals.goal: Keep Kastamonu and Sinop
goals.reason: Dynasty survival; Sinop trade
goals.deviation: Ottoman vassal under Süleyman

goals.goal: Kadi Burhan al-Din takes the throne
goals.reason: Weak Eretnid ruler; Burhan al-Din's ambition
goals.deviation: Stay vizier under Mehmed Çelebi

goals.goal: Hold Sivas, Kayseri and Amasya against Karaman, Ottomans and Turkmen
goals.reason: Central Anatolian power
goals.deviation: Ally with the Mamluks

goals.goal: Stay independent of Sivas
goals.reason: Former governors' ambition
goals.deviation: Accept Timur (1387)

goals.goal: Win autonomy from the Mamluks
goals.reason: Khalil's ambitions; Malatya
goals.deviation: Loyal buffer

goals.goal: Hold Adana and the Cilician plain
goals.reason: Gains from the fall of Armenia
goals.deviation: Ally with Karaman

goals.goal: Survive by marriages with Turkmen lords
goals.reason: Mountain kingdom ringed by Turkmen
goals.deviation: Seek Georgian protection

goals.goal: Keep the Tabriz trade
goals.reason: Main revenue

goals.goal: Restore the kingdom after the plague and keep the great lords loyal
goals.reason: Bagrat V's restoration policy
goals.deviation: Push against the Turkmen in Armenia

goals.goal: Resist Timur
goals.reason: Timur's campaigns 1386-1403
goals.deviation: Submit and convert (as Bagrat in 1386)

goals.goal: Stay a loyal great vassal
goals.reason: Royal strength under Bagrat V
goals.deviation: Seek autonomy

goals.goal: Throw off the Jalayirids and take their land
goals.reason: Turkmen expansion
goals.deviation: Ally with the Jalayirids against Timur

goals.goal: Win pastures and Diyarbakır
goals.reason: Nomad growth; rivalry with the Qara Qoyunlu
goals.deviation: Serve Timur or Burhan al-Din

goals.goal: Survive as a Jalayirid dependency
goals.reason: Small Caspian realm
goals.deviation: Submit to Tokhtamysh or Timur

goals.goal: Keep the mountains free
goals.reason: Autonomy
goals.deviation: Raid lowlands

goals.goal: Secure the crowns for Louis's daughters (Mary and Sigismund in Hungary and Poland; Jadwiga's Habsburg match)
goals.reason: No male heir; the Angevin dynasty must survive
goals.ends_when: Louis dead and a successor crowned in each kingdom
goals.deviation: Give Poland to Jadwiga alone and keep Hungary for Mary (what the Poles forced)

goals.goal: Humble Venice in the War of Chioggia; keep Dalmatia and win tribute
goals.reason: Venice wants Dalmatia back; Louis wants the Adriatic and a Venetian tribute
goals.ends_when: Peace with Venice that keeps Dalmatia (Turin 1381)
goals.deviation: Settle early with Venice to free troops for Naples

goals.goal: Put Charles of Durazzo on the throne of Naples
goals.reason: Angevin claim, revenge for Andrew (1345); Urban VI deposes Joanna after she backs Clement VII
goals.ends_when: Charles crowned in Naples (1381) or the Durazzo line dead
goals.deviation: Claim Naples for Louis himself or for Mary

goals.goal: Enforce overlordship on Wallachia, Moldavia, Bosnia and Vidin
goals.reason: Angevin Balkan policy and Catholic mission on the frontier
goals.ends_when: Ottomans hold the Danube line, or the princes submit
goals.deviation: Turn to an anti-Ottoman league once the Ottomans reach the Danube (Sigismund's course, 1390s)

goals.goal: Keep Galicia-Ruthenia under the Hungarian crown
goals.reason: Louis's plan to attach Rus to Hungary; salt and the Black Sea route
goals.deviation: Hand it to Poland as the price of the succession deal

goals.goal: Get a king who lives in Poland
goals.reason: Absentee Hungarian rule, riots in Kraków (1376), the lords' wish for their own court
goals.deviation: Elect a Piast: Siemowit IV of Mazovia was the lesser nobles' candidate (1382-83)

goals.goal: Union with pagan Lithuania through a royal marriage
goals.reason: Ends Lithuanian raids, gains an ally against the Order, settles Ruthenia, converts the pagans (dormant until 1382)
goals.ends_when: Union concluded (Krewo 1385) or Lithuania baptized another way
goals.deviation: Marriage with the Habsburg William, allied with Hungary instead

goals.goal: Recover Ruthenia: Galicia, Chełm, Belz, Volhynia, Podolia
goals.reason: Casimir's conquests; Hungarian and Lithuanian rivals
goals.deviation: Accept Lithuanian Volhynia for peace and look to Pomerania

goals.goal: Regain Pomerelia and Dobrzyń from the Order
goals.reason: Lost in 1308 and 1343; Dobrzyń pawned 1392
goals.deviation: Keep the peace of Kalisz

goals.goal: Stop the crusade: defend Samogitia and Trakai, end the Reisen
goals.reason: Yearly raids; the Order wants Samogitia to join Prussia to Livonia
goals.deviation: Buy peace by ceding Samogitia (Dubysa 1382, Salynas 1398)

goals.goal: Jogaila rules alone: free himself of Kęstutis and of his brother Andrei
goals.reason: Seniority rivalry inside the Gediminids
goals.deviation: Keep the diarchy until Kęstutis dies naturally

goals.goal: Gather the Rus lands against Moscow (Smolensk, Upper Oka, influence in Tver and Novgorod)
goals.reason: Gediminid expansion; Algirdas's wars with Moscow
goals.ends_when: Moscow wins (Kulikovo) or the lands are held
goals.deviation: Seek an Orthodox marriage and baptism with Moscow (the draft treaty with Dmitry, 1384)

goals.goal: Baptism on Lithuanian terms, via a crown
goals.reason: Christianity removes the crusade's reason; a crown brings allies
goals.deviation: Orthodox baptism with a Muscovite bride

goals.goal: Alliance with Mamai against Dmitry
goals.reason: Common enemy in Moscow
goals.deviation: Stay out and watch Moscow and the Horde wear each other down (what happened in effect)

goals.goal: Win Samogitia and break pagan Lithuania by Reisen
goals.reason: Crusading purpose, Western knights, a land bridge to Livonia
goals.ends_when: Lithuania Christian and Samogitia held or given up for good
goals.deviation: Turn from war to trade and land purchase (Gotland, Neumark)

goals.goal: Back one side in the Lithuanian civil war
goals.reason: Divide Lithuania, gain Samogitia as payment
goals.deviation: Back Kęstutis and Vytautas instead of Jogaila

goals.goal: Keep the peace of Kalisz with Poland
goals.reason: Holding Pomerelia and Chełmno safely
goals.deviation: Stir Poland's succession quarrel

goals.goal: Lordship over Riga, city and archbishopric
goals.reason: Sole power in Livonia
goals.ends_when: Riga chapter incorporated (1394) or archbishop beaten
goals.deviation: Accept a split lordship and turn on Pskov

goals.goal: Raid Lithuania with Prussia
goals.reason: Crusade
goals.deviation: Raid Pskov and Novgorod's lands

goals.goal: Stay free of the Order: papal and Lithuanian protectors
goals.reason: The Order wants to incorporate the chapter
goals.deviation: Accept the Order's terms in return for the city

goals.goal: Keep self-rule against both lords
goals.reason: Hanse town wants its liberties
goals.deviation: Side with the archbishop against the Order

goals.goal: Keep its lands and trade between the Order, Pskov and Novgorod
goals.reason: Small frontier see on the Russian trade
goals.deviation: Seek a Lithuanian or Hanse protector

goals.goal: Keep the Order out of the chapter
goals.reason: Bishops' independence
goals.deviation: Seek papal protection

goals.goal: Stay independent of Hungary by leaning on Poland
goals.reason: Bogdan's revolt against Hungary; Hungarian claims
goals.ends_when: Homage to Poland on good terms (1387), or Hungary gives up
goals.deviation: Accept Hungarian overlordship if Hungary is strong

goals.goal: Reach the Danube and Black Sea (Chilia, Cetatea Albă)
goals.reason: Trade route from Lviv to the Black Sea
goals.deviation: Expand north into Pokuttya and Shypyntsi

goals.goal: Win its own Orthodox metropolitan
goals.reason: Church independence from Galicia's see
goals.deviation: Keep the Latin bishopric of Siret as a link to the West

goals.goal: Stay free of direct Lithuanian rule, playing Moscow against Vilnius
goals.reason: Rurikid independence
goals.deviation: Accept Lithuanian overlordship for protection from Moscow

goals.goal: Hold Volhynia for Lubart's line against Poland and Hungary
goals.reason: Last Galician-Volhynian heir
goals.deviation: Submit to the Polish crown for Lutsk

goals.goal: Keep Mazovia's autonomy; later a Piast claim to the Polish crown
goals.reason: Siemowit IV is a candidate in 1382-83
goals.deviation: Follow the Polish court

goals.goal: Break Mamai and stop paying tribute
goals.reason: Mamai is a usurper, not a Chinggisid; Moscow's strength after the 1370s
goals.ends_when: Mamai dead (1380-81) or tribute resumed to a lawful khan
goals.deviation: Pay off Mamai and build strength first

goals.goal: Keep the Vladimir title and hold Tver, Ryazan and Nizhny as juniors
goals.reason: Rivalry for the grand title; Mikhail of Tver's yarlyks of 1371 and 1375
goals.ends_when: Tver gives up for good, Nizhny annexed (1392)
goals.deviation: Strike Ryazan directly to settle the Oka border

goals.goal: Seat a metropolitan of its own choice in Moscow
goals.reason: Alexius dead (Feb 1378); Cyprian is Lithuania's man; Mityai is Dmitry's candidate
goals.ends_when: A metropolitan acceptable to Moscow sits there (Cyprian 1390)
goals.deviation: Accept Cyprian early for church unity

goals.goal: Win over Lithuanian dissidents and push west (Bryansk, Trubchevsk, Smolensk)
goals.reason: Algirdas's sons quarrel with Jogaila; the Orthodox of Lithuania
goals.ends_when: Dissidents gone home or killed; truce with Lithuania
goals.deviation: A marriage alliance with Jogaila and his Orthodox baptism (draft of 1384)

goals.goal: Annex Nizhny Novgorod-Suzdal
goals.reason: Volga trade, the frontier, family claim through Evdokia (weak until Dmitry Konstantinovich dies)
goals.deviation: Keep it as an allied buffer

goals.goal: Win back the Vladimir title
goals.reason: Tver's old claim; Mamai and later Tokhtamysh sell yarlyks
goals.ends_when: Mikhail dead (1399) or Moscow's title secure
goals.deviation: Stay quiet and look to Lithuania for protection

goals.goal: Keep the Lithuanian alliance
goals.reason: Kinship with Jogaila; balance against Moscow
goals.deviation: Side with Moscow against the Tatars (1375 treaty terms)

goals.goal: Master the appanage princes (Kashin)
goals.reason: Kashin leans to Moscow
goals.deviation: Leave Kashin and seek gains at Novgorod's expense

goals.goal: Survive between Mamai and Moscow
goals.reason: Ryazan is the first land the steppe hits; the Vozha brought Mamai's revenge
goals.deviation: Join Moscow fully against the Tatars

goals.goal: Recover Kolomna and Lopasnya from Moscow
goals.reason: Old border losses
goals.ends_when: Holds them, or a lasting treaty (1381, 1385-86)
goals.deviation: Expand into the empty steppe to the south

goals.goal: Keep Pronsk subordinate
goals.reason: Pronsk princes turn to Moscow
goals.deviation: Partition the house with Moscow's blessing

goals.goal: Defend the Volga frontier against the Tatars and Mordva
goals.reason: Pyana and the sacks of 1377-78
goals.deviation: Strike first at Bulgar with Moscow (as in 1376)

goals.goal: Stay independent of Moscow
goals.reason: Its own grand title; Moscow covets it
goals.deviation: Back the Horde's khan against Moscow (1382) to win his patent

goals.goal: Keep its liberties and play Moscow against Lithuania
goals.reason: The grand prince wants more black tribute and control
goals.deviation: Take a Lithuanian service prince as protector (Patrikii 1383, Lengvenis 1389)

goals.goal: Hold its northern lands and tribute (Dvina, Perm, Pechora) against Moscow
goals.reason: The north is its wealth (furs)
goals.deviation: Push the ushkuiniki down the Volga for plunder

goals.goal: Hold Karelia and the Neva against Sweden
goals.reason: Old frontier war
goals.deviation: Keep peace and focus on trade

goals.goal: Defend against the Livonian Order
goals.reason: Constant raids
goals.deviation: Seek Lithuanian help instead

goals.goal: Stay free of Novgorod, with Moscow as protector
goals.reason: Bolotovo freedom; Novgorod's claims
goals.deviation: Take a Lithuanian prince

goals.goal: Hold Soldaia and win the Gothia coast from the Tatars
goals.reason: Security of Caffa's hinterland, grain and slave trade
goals.deviation: Pay the khan and stay inside the walls

goals.goal: Keep Venice out of the Black Sea trade
goals.reason: War of Chioggia
goals.deviation: Trade truce at Tana

goals.goal: Hold the Gothia coast against Genoa
goals.reason: Coastal villages and ports
goals.deviation: Ally with the Tatars against Genoa

goals.goal: Put Tokhtamysh on the White Horde throne at Sighnaq
goals.reason: A grateful Jochid client secures Timur's northern flank and the Syr Darya towns; Urus Khan had threatened Timur directly.
goals.ends_when: Tokhtamysh holds Sighnaq (likely done at the start), or Tokhtamysh is dead or hostile.
goals.deviation: Back an Urusid instead, or annex Sighnaq and the Syr Darya towns outright.

goals.goal: Take Urgench and all Khwarazm
goals.reason: Khwarazm is claimed as Chagatai land; Yusuf Sufi refused to give up the south and raided Timur's lands.
goals.ends_when: Timur holds Urgench; revives if Urgench rebels (history 1388).
goals.deviation: Accept Sufid tribute and turn to Khorasan first.

goals.goal: Break Qamar ud-Din and subdue Moghulistan
goals.reason: A non-Chinggisid usurper raids Ferghana; Timur poses as restorer of the Chagatai ulus.
goals.ends_when: Qamar ud-Din dead or fled, or a Moghul khan submits (history: Khizr Khoja, 1397).
goals.deviation: Leave Moghulistan alone and go east to China early.

goals.goal: Conquer Khorasan: Herat, Sabzevar, Tus, Astarabad, then Sistan and Qandahar
goals.reason: Rich, divided neighbours; booty and land for his amirs; Pir Ali refuses his quriltai (1380).
goals.ends_when: Timur holds Herat, Sabzevar and Astarabad.
goals.deviation: Turn west to the Jalayirids and Muzaffarids first.

goals.goal: Punish Tokhtamysh (latent: live only once Tokhtamysh, as khan of the united Horde, attacks Timur's land or claims Khwarazm or Azerbaijan by war)
goals.reason: Tokhtamysh's betrayal: Tabriz (1385), Khwarazm, Transoxiana (1387-88).
goals.ends_when: Tokhtamysh dead or no longer khan of the Horde.
goals.deviation: Make peace and split the steppe, and turn to India or China.

goals.goal: Keep Moghulistan free of Timur
goals.reason: Timur's repeated campaigns; the usurper survives only if Timur fails.
goals.deviation: Make peace with Timur by marriage.

goals.goal: Raid Ferghana and the Syr Darya
goals.reason: Plunder and revenge; Umar Shaykh in Andijan is exposed.
goals.ends_when: Ferghana well defended, or peace with Timur.
goals.deviation: Ally with Tokhtamysh against Timur (history 1387-88).

goals.goal: Remove the Chagatayid claimant Khizr Khoja
goals.reason: Qamar ud-Din is no Chinggisid; a living heir threatens him.
goals.deviation: Accept Khizr Khoja as figurehead khan.

goals.goal: Hold Tabriz and Azerbaijan
goals.reason: Tabriz, the Ilkhanid capital, is the base of Jalayirid legitimacy; Shah Shuja took it in 1375.
goals.ends_when: Tabriz held with the Muzaffarid threat gone, or Azerbaijan lost for good.
goals.deviation: Withdraw to Baghdad and build Iraq.

goals.goal: Keep the Qara Qoyunlu and Shirvan in submission
goals.reason: Tribute, troops and the route to Anatolia.
goals.deviation: Ally with the Qara Qoyunlu as equals against Timur.

goals.goal: Settle the brothers' appanages
goals.reason: Ahmad (Ardabil), Bayazid (Sultaniyya) and Shaykh Ali (Iraq) each have a base and a claim.
goals.ends_when: One brother rules alone (history: Ahmad kills Husayn, 1382).
goals.deviation: Grant a brother a permanent subject realm.

goals.goal: Take Tabriz and Azerbaijan
goals.reason: Shah Shuja's ambition to the Ilkhanid inheritance; the 1375 attempt.
goals.ends_when: Holds Tabriz, or Shah Shuja dead (1384).
goals.deviation: Expand toward Khuzistan and lower Iraq.

goals.goal: Keep Yazd and Kerman loyal
goals.reason: Shah Yahya at Yazd rebels repeatedly; family appanages pull away.
goals.ends_when: Branches loyal under one ruler, or the realm splits.
goals.deviation: Grant Yazd as a hereditary subject.

goals.goal: Avoid Timur by submission and gifts
goals.reason: Timur's power on the Oxus; Shah Shuja's will commends his sons to Timur.
goals.ends_when: Timur dead or weak, or already at war with Fars.
goals.deviation: Ally with the Jalayirids against Timur.

goals.goal: Take Nishapur and western Khorasan from the Sarbadars
goals.reason: Sunni-Shi'i rivalry and the wealth of Nishapur.
goals.deviation: Combine with the Sarbadars against Timur.

goals.goal: Stay independent of Timur
goals.reason: An old dynasty refusing a new overlord; Herat's walls.
goals.deviation: Accept Timur as overlord and keep the throne.

goals.goal: Hold Sabzevar against the dervish party, Amir Wali and the Kartids
goals.reason: The regime is split and has hostile neighbours on three sides.
goals.ends_when: Enemies broken, or Sabzevar has a protector.
goals.deviation: Seek Timur's protection early (history 1381).

goals.goal: Hold Urgench and win back Kath and Khiva
goals.reason: All Khwarazm was the Sufid inheritance; Timur took the south in 1373.
goals.ends_when: Holds all Khwarazm, or Urgench falls.
goals.deviation: Seek Jochid protection (Tokhtamysh; history 1387).

goals.goal: Destroy the Sarbadars
goals.reason: Long feud and rivalry for western Khorasan.
goals.ends_when: Sabzevar taken, or Amir Wali dead.
goals.deviation: Combine with the Sarbadars against Timur.

goals.goal: Resist Timur
goals.reason: An independent lordship with no claim to mercy.
goals.deviation: Submit and serve as a Timurid amir.

goals.goal: Settle the succession between Pir Ahmad and Hushang
goals.reason: Contested inheritance after Pashang.
goals.deviation: Seek a Muzaffarid or Jalayirid patron.

goals.goal: Keep autonomy and the tolls on the Zagros roads
goals.reason: A mountain lordship lives on its passes.
goals.deviation: Nominal submission to the strongest.

goals.goal: Hold the Caspian plain against the Paduspanids and Amir Wali
goals.reason: Sayyid rule is new (1359) and ringed by older lords.
goals.deviation: Expand into Rustamdar outright.

goals.goal: Subdue Biya-pas
goals.reason: Sayyid Ali Kiya's drive to rule all Gilan.
goals.ends_when: Holds Rasht and Fuman, or Ali Kiya dead (1389).
goals.deviation: Switch allegiance to the strongest plateau power.

goals.goal: Hold out against the Mar'ashis
goals.reason: Ancient dynasty under pressure from the sayyids.
goals.deviation: Hold out in the mountains.

goals.goal: Keep the malikate and the Helmand towns
goals.reason: Old local dynasty; Kartids and Timur close.
goals.deviation: Seek a new overlord.

goals.goal: Keep autonomy and the gem trade
goals.reason: Remote mountain shahs living on rubies and lapis.
goals.ends_when: A strong Oxus power annexes it.
goals.deviation: Submit.

goals.goal: Punish Moscow and restore Rus tribute
goals.reason: Rus tribute is the Horde's wealth and Mamai's prestige; Dmitry stopped paying and won at the Vozha.
goals.ends_when: Moscow pays again, or Mamai falls.
goals.deviation: Leave Rus and turn first on Tokhtamysh.

goals.goal: Ally with Lithuania and Ryazan against Moscow
goals.reason: A coalition to make the 1380 campaign certain.
goals.deviation: Raid Lithuania and Poland instead.

goals.goal: Hold Sarai and the Volga for the puppet khan
goals.reason: A khan must sit at Sarai to be believed; Arab Shah and Tokhtamysh contest it.
goals.ends_when: Mamai holds Sarai with no rival, or Mamai falls.
goals.deviation: Accept a division of the steppe.

goals.goal: Keep the Genoese as paymasters; win back Soldaia
goals.reason: Money and mercenaries from the Crimean ports; the 1365 loss of Soldaia.
goals.deviation: Make Caffa a full ally and rely on Genoese loans.

goals.goal: Defeat Tokhtamysh (strong once he moves west)
goals.reason: A Chinggisid rival makes Mamai's puppets worthless.
goals.deviation: Recognise Tokhtamysh as khan and stay beylerbey.

goals.goal: After the union (Tokhtamysh): re-impose tribute on Rus
goals.reason: The united Horde needs Rus silver; Kulikovo must be undone.
goals.deviation: Use Lithuania against Moscow instead.

goals.goal: After the union (Tokhtamysh): claim Azerbaijan and Khwarazm as Jochid lands
goals.reason: The old Jochid claim from Berke's wars; this is what makes him break with Timur.
goals.ends_when: Holds Tabriz and Urgench, or Tokhtamysh no longer khan.
goals.deviation: Stay Timur's loyal client and turn on Lithuania and the Rus.

goals.goal: Hold Sighnaq and the White Horde against Urus Khan's sons
goals.reason: His throne; Timur-Malik and his kin are rivals.
goals.ends_when: Holds Sighnaq with the Urusid line beaten or fled.
goals.deviation: Stay in Timur's service and wait.

goals.goal: Take Sarai and unite the Ulus of Jochi
goals.reason: A Chinggisid claim to the whole ulus; Mamai is a non-Chinggisid usurper.
goals.ends_when: Holds Sarai and Mamai has fallen (the merge into great_horde).
goals.deviation: Content himself with the eastern ulus and raid.

goals.goal: Keep Timur's alliance
goals.reason: Timur's money and men put him on the throne.
goals.ends_when: Union achieved and Jochid claims clash with Timur's.
goals.deviation: Break with Timur early and claim Khwarazm.

goals.goal: Hold the Volga and raid Nizhny Novgorod
goals.reason: Plunder and a claim to Sarai.
goals.ends_when: Arab Shah loses the Volga, or joins the strongest khan.
goals.deviation: Join Tokhtamysh (history).

goals.goal: Throw off Moscow's tribute and officials
goals.reason: Imposed by force in 1376.
goals.ends_when: Moscow's officials gone, or Moscow strong on the Volga.
goals.deviation: Return to the Horde's protection (history: under Tokhtamysh).
